notes.title: Parkour Civilization
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3295890/PARKOUR_CIVILIZATION/

[b]Raise your Social Status by doing Parkour and Become a Parkour Pro![/b]

If you've ever wondered whether you could master a leap in [b]Parkour Civilization[/b], now’s your chance to find out! Join the parkour challenge in the Parkour Civilization universe. Is there a better feeling than beating your friends to the summit? We doubt it! That’s why the [u]game also includes multiplayer[/u]! ːsteamhappyː

But parkour isn’t the only activity! You can also [u]collect items[/u] to [u]craft cool things[/u] like a campfire or a grappling gun. And don’t forget to buy a stylish house as you level up! Oh, and be sure to turn your headphones on—the sound changes depending on the surface you’re jumping onto!

Don't forget to [u]leave a Steam Review[/u] once you've played it! ːsteamthumbsupː/ːsteamthumbsdownː

Have fun!
[i]The Sweepy Games Team[/i]
